questions.q: Which Outlook trigger starts a flow whenever a new message arrives in a mailbox?
options: Get emails (V3)
When a new email arrives (V3)
Send an email (V2)
When an event is added, updated, or deleted (V3)
questions.explain: When a new email arrives (V3) is the trigger that starts a flow on an incoming message. It can be filtered by sender, subject, or importance.

questions.q: A trigger has Include Attachments set to No. What happens to an incoming email's attachment data?
options: The flow fails immediately
Only metadata (name, size, content type) comes through; the actual file content does not
The attachment is automatically deleted from the mailbox
Nothing changes — attachments always fully come through regardless of this setting
questions.explain: Attachment metadata always comes through regardless of this setting. The actual file content is only included when Include Attachments is turned on.

questions.q: Why can't a flow just wire the trigger's Attachments output directly into Send an email (V2)'s Attachments field when it needs to filter out some attachments first?
options: Send an email doesn't support attachments at all
The Attachments field expects a single array you control, so building a filtered/modified set requires looping and appending into your own array variable first
Attachments can only be sent one at a time, never as an array
Outlook attachments can only be forwarded, never newly attached
questions.explain: To send a filtered or modified set of attachments, you loop over the trigger's attachments with Apply to each, append the ones you want to an array variable, and reference that variable in the Attachments field instead of the trigger's raw output.

questions.q: In the Castlebridge Logistics exception-handling example, what is the array variable's role in the flow?
options: It stores the sender's email address for later use
It accumulates the specific attachments (excluding things like signature images) that should go out on the forwarded claim notice
It counts how many emails have arrived that day
It holds the subject line of the incoming email
questions.explain: The Apply to each loop appends only the attachments that should be forwarded — filtering out things like signature images — building the exact attachment set used in the outgoing Send an email action.

questions.q: Which Outlook action would you use to pass an existing incoming message along to a different recipient without composing a new email from scratch?
options: Get emails (V3)
Create event (V4)
Forward an email (V2)
When a new email arrives (V3)
questions.explain: Forward an email (V2) forwards an existing message to a new recipient or group, which saves composing a new message when the original content just needs to be routed elsewhere.
